name: SPT-VR
teaser: SPT-VR brings the immersive, intense experience of Tarkov into the realm of virtual reality. Engage in intense firefights, loot dangerous environments, and survive the unforgiving world of Tarkov—all in full VR.
description:
WARNING: This is an overhaul mod, please treat it as such. That means, don’t install this on top of your current SPT install with a bunch of mods. This mod should always be started on a clean slate. Install other mods one by one and test, if it has issues, remove it.

IMPORTANT: Strongly recommend installing my cloud mod with this also, default Tarkov clouds don’t work in VR and your skies will just be cloudless without it - https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2567/cloudsix-cloud-replacement

SPT-VR (Single Player Tarkov VR Mod)

SPT-VR brings the immersive, intense experience of Tarkov into the realm of virtual reality. Engage in intense firefights, loot dangerous environments, and survive the unforgiving world of Tarkov—all in full VR.

Table of Contents

  1. Setup
  2. Controls
  3. FPS/Graphics Guide
  4. FAQ
  5. Contributions
  6. Development Environment Setup
  7. Get in contact

Setup

Prerequisites

  • Single Player Tarkov (SPT) Installation: Make sure you have a working copy of SPT installed.
  • SteamVR: The mod requires SteamVR to support VR hardware.

Installation Steps

  1. Ensure SPT is up to date: Make sure you have the latest version of SPT installed on your system.
  2. Download the latest release: On the right side of this page (if on GitHub), download the latest release from the “Releases” section.
  3. Navigate to SPT’s root directory: This should contain the SPT.Launcher, SPT.Server files, and the BepInEx folder.
  4. Extract the downloaded files: Merge the folders from the release with the folders in the SPT installation.
  5. Launch SteamVR: Ensure that SteamVR is running and your headset is connected before launching the game.
  6. Launch the game through the SPT Launcher.

Uninstalling

To uninstall the mod, go to your SPT installation and remove the BepInEx/plugins/sptvr/SPT-VR.dll file, which will stop the game from launching in VR. To reinstall it, simply drag the .dll file back into the directory.

Controls

Movement

  • Walking: Left joystick.
  • Look around: Right joystick.
  • Sprint: Click the right joystick.
  • Jump: Push the right joystick up.
  • Vault: Hold the right joystick up at a ledge.
  • Crouch: Pull down on the right joystick, physically crouch, or do both.
  • Prone: Fully crouch, release the joystick, then pull down again.

Weapon Controls

  • Fire: Right trigger.
  • Two-hand weapon: Support the gun with the left grip when it vibrates (toggle option available).
  • Aim: Looking down the sights automatically increases accuracy.
  • Steady aim: Hold the left trigger to hold your breath.
  • Weapon interaction mode: Hold the right grip when not aiming to interact with the weapon:
    • Check Magazine
    • Reload
    • Inspect Weapon
    • Fix Malfunction
    • Toggle Firemode
    • Fold Stock (not implemented yet)
  • Reload: Press B or use the interaction mode.
  • Toggle Firemode: Press A or use the interaction mode when two-handing.
  • Change red dot/holo mode: Press the left grip when your hand vibrates near the sight.
  • Change optic zoom: Pull the right joystick or rotate the left hand near the scope.
  • Grenades: Select from the quick slot radial menu, then hold the right trigger to pull the pin, trigger will act as grip, do throwing motion and let go of trigger to throw. Press left trigger while pin is pulled to reset pin and cancel throw
  • Toggle Tactical Device: While holding secondary grip, press Y on secondary controller, long press Y to toggle other modes
  • Under Barrel Grenade Launcher: While holding gun with other hand, hold secondary controller trigger and press X

In-Game Interactions

  • Swap Weapon:
    1. For a pistol, bring your right hand to your hip and press the right grip.
    2. For primary weapons, bring your right hand to your shoulder and press the right grip.
    3. Use the radial menu by holding the right grip at your shoulder.
  • Quick Slot Items: Open the radial menu by putting your hand in backpack (over non-dominant shoulder) and press and hold grip, bring into view while keeping grip held, select item with thumbstick and let go of grip
  • Interacting with doors/containers/bodies/loose loot/etc:
    1. Through a menu by looking at the object, which will bring up the menu where you’re looking, then using the right joystick you can navigate it and use the A button to select an option.
    2. Bring your left hand up to the object and press the left grip to perform the primary operation, or with loose loot you can hold the left grip to pick it up and bring it over your left shoulder and release to place it in your inventory if there is room.
  • Toggle head visor/night vision: These can be toggled by bringing the left hand up to your head and pressing the left grip.
  • Toggle Head light: Left hand by head and press trigger instead of grip
  • Drop Backpack: Put left hand in backpack collider (over non-dominant shoulder) and press trigger

Menus & Menu Interactions

  • Select: To interact with menu items, buttons, etc, press the A button while hovering over it with your laser pointer.
  • Open Inventory: Press X while in a raid.
  • Open Menu: Press Y while in a raid.
  • Dragging Items: Hold the right trigger to move items.
  • Opening Item Sub-Menu: While hovering over an item, hold down the A button to bring up a dropdown menu for that item.
  • Opening Item Display Window: Double tap A while hovering over an item to open the item display window.
  • Quick Equip: While holding the left grip, pressing the A button on an item will automatically equip it to its respective slot.
  • Quick Transfer Item: While holding the right grip, pressing the A button on an item will automatically transfer it in or out of your inventory.

Configuring your experience

If you go into the Tarkov settings menu, you will see a VR tab, which allows you to modify some of the VR-specific settings.

Performance Guide!

For reference my specs -

AMD 9070 XT

32GB of ram

Ryzen 5 7600x

NVME SSD

  1. Install VRAMCleaner - VRAM Cleaner
  2. Set all graphics settings to lowest/off except textures, shadows, anisotropic, and LOD/visibility (set those to whatever you want) AA should always be set to off or FXAA, nothing else works (set texture to medium or low if you have 10GB VRAM or less)
  3. Check boxes on graphics settings at bottom, Grass shadows, high quality color, and streets low quality textures. Everything else unchecked, volumetric lighting is your preference. Another checkbox I suggest using if you are 10GB or less VRAM is Mip Streaming. This free’s up A LOT of VRAM and can help a lot with performance on lower VRAM cards
  4. Use an upscaler - Nvidia DLSS - AMD FSR3
  5. In SteamVR settings, go into your tarkov video settings and set the resolution in there to 100-150%. This is one of the things that hurts performance the most, the lower the better. You need a lot of VRAM if you want to run this at a high resolution (keep in mind if you’re using an upscaler, this setting plays together with that)
  6. Learn how to use a headless Fika client, I don’t recommend running headless through your own PC but it can help performance, just make sure you have AT LEAST 64GB of ram. In reality, you should run a headless client on a separate PC on your network that has at least 32GB of ram and a decent CPU
  7. Install a bot spawner mod such as MOAR or ABPS, these are also big helps to performance because the main killer of performance in SPT is the AI. These mods are much better at managing spawns.
  8. Last thing I’d suggest which may not apply for many people, I disable my 4k monitor whenever I play which seems to help a bit.

IMPORTANT: This mod is a very heavy mod, it will not run on a low-end or mid-grade PC. This requires a very high-end PC.

Minimum GPU Nvidia - Any 30 series+ with 16GB+ of VRAM

Minimum GPU AMD - Any RX 7000+ RDNA3/4 with 16GB+ of VRAM.

Minimum CPU - Really I can’t recommend anything other than the AMD X3D chips like the 5800x3d, 9800x3d, etc

Minimum RAM: 32GB if you have a secondary headless PC, if you’re self hosting you should really have more than 32GB

Minimum drive - SSD or NVMe SSD, preferably NVMe but this isn’t a big deal

You may be able to get away with slightly lower specs but this is what I recommend to have an actual playable experience.

FAQ

What controllers and headsets are supported?

The mod supports most VR headsets. The following controllers work out of the box:

  • Quest 2/3
  • Valve Index
  • Vive

If your controller isn’t working, configure the control scheme through SteamVR bindings.

Does this work with the non-SPT Escape From Tarkov?

No, using this mod with the official version of Escape From Tarkov can result in a ban.

Does it support FIKA?

Yes, it supports FIKA and is fully synced. So you will see other VR players movements and they will see yours, flatscreen players included. If you are using FIKA, you NEED to have the sync module installed that is included in the download. Everyone that connects will need to have it too including flatscreen players otherwise you will have a lot of issues.

Are other mods compatible with the VR mod?

Several mods have been confirmed to work. However, mods that add a new UI may not work, new guns might be missing features, and some graphics mods may cause issues. Please remove all incompatible mods before reporting any bugs.

Current list of known compatible mods:

  • FIKA
  • Hollywood Graphics/FX
  • SAIN
  • Waypoints
  • Declutterer
  • BigBrain
  • Epic’s AIO modded scopes (still needs some work)
  • A lot of others, my best suggestion is to try one at a time, most UI mods that add totally new UI elements will not work properly

Do I need to buy this mod?

No, the mod is free, and the source code is open-source.

Contributions

A huge thank you to these primary testers who helped shape the mod:

  • groundzeroday: Check out his work at hexler.net
  • Havviks: Thanks for making the trailer, go watch his videos on YouTube
  • MaTSix: Offered a lot of helpful ideas which greatly decreased the jankiness of the mod

Get in contact

Join the discord - https://discord.gg/U8B8h3s6SN

If you want to reach out to me personally, you can send an email to cybensis@protonmail.com

Development Environment Setup

If you wish to make your own changes to the mod or want to check it out for any purpose, follow the steps below:

  1. Clone the Repository: This can either be done by downloading the source code from the GitHub page or using the command below: git clone https://github.com/cybensis/SPT-VR.git
  2. Open it in your IDE: I’ve only ever used Visual Studio for development, so I would recommend using that. Opening the .sln file will open Visual Studio, which should already be configured to build without issue.
  3. Make your changes and build: After making your changes, to test them simply go to the Build dropdown menu at the top of Visual Studio and select Build Solution.
  4. Add the build to your SPT installation: After building the mod, you should find the new file under bin/Debug/TarkovVR.dll or bin/Release/TarkovVR.dll depending on whether you’ve built a debug or release version. Then, in your SPT installation, replace the BepInEx/plugins/sptvr/SPT-VR.dll file with your new one and you should be good to go.
custom_ai_disclosure: Helps to write the code and reverse engineer the game, I am very open about this. This is a very complex project for a very err… complex? game that does not like being modded. Not sure if this mod would be possible without the help of AI… unless you’re a psychopath. Kidding, there’s some really talented people out there, I am just a dude making my dream VR game. So I use what I can.

category.description: Large-scale mod packs that overhaul many game systems. Typically combines both client-side and server-side mods into one package.

versions.description:
Major Update Changelog:

NOTE: This is a massive update. So, I expect bugs to come up. I tested as much as I could and fixed as much as I could but there’s no way I could account for every issue. So please, let me know of bugs that come up either in the comments here or on the SPT-VR discord.

IF YOU ARE RUNNING FIKA, FIKASYNC NEEDS TO BE INSTALLED ON ALL CLIENTS INCLUDING HEADLESS, IT IS INCLUDED IN THE ZIP

Manual Eating Interactions

  • Manual food eating! First step towards manual interactions, going to be implementing new interactions throughout this year
  • All foods now have unique gestures for manual eating, they’re setup to be pretty intuitive and simple, tried to make it as seamless as possible where you barely need to think about it

Body Dragging

  • Added dragging AI bodies around (scavs will still loot the body at it’s original location, I’ll see if I can fix this)
  • Added dragging teammates body while it’s in revive state when using Fika
  • To loot a body instead of drag, do a quick grip and let go

Full FIKA Sync

  • Synced arms over Fika, other players will now see where you’re aiming
  • Synced manual eating
  • Synced body dragging
  • Synced loose loot holding
  • Synced melee hit effects
  • Created a separate Fika Sync .dll module so flatscreen players can install it and see the VR player movements too

Performance

  • Added lodbiasfactor slider in VR More settings (big performance boost when lowered but causes a lot of pop-in)
  • Fixed frustum culling for distant tree’s, they won’t disappear on the far right of vision anymore
  • Added option to change scope resolution in VR settings menu

Loose Loot Interaction

  • White dot will show up on items within a cone coming from the palm of your hand, the circle will grow/shrink based on another smaller raycast coming from your palm. So if multiple items are next to each other, you still have fine control over which item you select. Press grip from a distance when white dot is visible, it’ll pull the item to your hand
  • Interact context menu now stays centered on where it is, even when the item it’s connected to is moving
  • Context menu will only come up on items when you’re holding and looking at it
  • Made it so joystick crouch/prone/jump is only blocked on context menus if the menu has more than one option to scroll to (makes use loose loot mod work, works perfectly with the manual eating) https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/933/use-loose-loot
  • Fixed null when taking an item that you are currently holding
  • Made it so if you have loose loot use mod installed and use food/drink while holding the item, it’ll put it in your inventory if there’s space, if not, it’ll drop the item and put you into eating/drinking state
  • Update to held item collision, if the collision causes the item to pull too far from your hand, it’ll auto drop the item. There’s some give to this so it wont just fall out of your hand with small bumps. For example, your hand will need to move about a foot away from whatever item your holding before it drops it
  • Significant improvement to held item stability, item gets parented to the hand. Little to no jitter at all while walking with item
  • Adjusted collision to use high poly collider instead of low poly for held items. This avoids mismatch of colliders when an item is dropped vs when you pick it up. This made clipping smaller items through stuff a lot harder
  • Held items will now be a lot harder to clip through collision, nearly impossible - when item meets collision, it’ll slide along the collision to try and stay connected to your hand, it won’t just get caught and stuck on collision anymore

VR Setting Menu

  • Smooth sliders for all VR slider settings so you can dial in exact offsets for things now, not limited to the ticks (all your current settings should be unchanged, the numbers in the settings menu are just different visibly to standardize and not just have a bunch of random numbers)
  • Scrollbar added to VR Settings menu - thanks killdns for the initial work on this, had to do a lot to get it working properly though in my headset and others
  • Added secondary VR settings menu called “VR More” which will be used for graphics and interaction related settings
  • Added disable mouse input toggle in VR More (fixes the issue where things get highlighted that your laser isn’t pointing at when toggled)
  • Added walkeffector toggle in VR settings (this adds walking animation for guns/hands)
  • Added option to toggle corpse context menu

IK Improvements

  • Various improvements to IK/Jitter
  • Improved left hand rest pose when not two handing a gun
  • Shoulders no longer go lower than they should when crouching, this helps keep IK working consistently even when crouched. They always will stay 1-1 with head height
  • When crouching both physically and with joystick, your character will now move 1-1 with you. For example, if you look down then crouch really fast, you won’t see your legs lagging behind
  • Fixed wrist twisting when running with disable run animation enabled (sometimes it starts twisting again I have no idea why, so not fully fixed yet)
  • Big improvement to overall stability when walking on uneven surfaces, this also significantly reduces that sudden jolt up/down when you start/stop walking while crouched

Variable Scope Rework

  • Total rework of variable scopes, it’s all using base Tarkov’s scope code now. I’m just taking full control of the FOV and making it analog. The result of this is that the scopes.json file is no longer needed and every scope should just work, even modded ones
  • Adjusted physical zoom dial to make the hand turn the direction you are actually turning your hand

UI Fixes

  • Edit build menu fully re-done, should work just like base eft now

Various Bug Fixes

  • Fixed sako and golden tt two handed grip
  • Laser pointer should now stay on loading screen all the way up until the countdown ends (only on fika, base spt is weird)
  • Fix to right click menu closing - no more stuck right click menu, if you click away from the menu, it’ll close now as it should

Mod support

  • Added support for weapon customizer mod (moving attachments on rails, it all #justworks)
  • Added support for Loose Loot Use mod, works perfectly with the manual eating

Git pulls from killdns- Thank you! - https://github.com/killdns

  • Held items will not get stuck mid air anymore while walking - fix by killdns
  • Arm stamina drain and weight gets added when holding an item - done by killdns
  • Vive wand compatibility improvement and scroll bar in VR settings menu - done by killdns

dependencies.name: CloudSix - Volumetric Clouds
dependencies.teaser: Replaces Tarkov's clouds with volumetric clouds using a custom shader built from the ground up

versions.description:
NOTE: Pictures in the imgur link in description have been updated to show the latest clouds

Update Changelog:

  • Rewrote the shader pretty much from the ground up again
  • New and improved lighting on all aspects - ambient scattering, cloud density, shading
  • Perspective/scale actually feels proper now
  • WAY more variety in cloud shapes/position
  • Randomized cloud wind direction every start of raid
  • Removed clouds from maps that shouldn’t have clouds (this includes factory)
  • Improved high clouds, they just look better and their coverage increases/decreases along with cumulus clouds
  • Ambient color is now pulled directly from the sky and it has made the clouds blend with the sky way better
  • Ground shadows! Yes, the clouds now will cast shadows on the ground (sometimes it takes a few seconds at raid start to kick in, this happens on base tarkov too, not sure why it happens)
  • So much more that I can’t think of

Hotfix Changelog:

  • Fixes an issue with not being able to extract after dying with the latest Fika

Quick Note - I know I’ve been pretty quiet/slow on updates for this mod lately. Kinda been obsessed with the side project with the clouds… but that’s now released into version 3.0.0 and it may even be the final version. So, any modding work I do going forward should just be on this VR mod.

Hotfix Changelog:

  • Added a patch to reduce VRAM usage of dynamic maps
  • Fixed the hang when opening the map with dynamic maps installed (this freeze actually happens on the flatscreen version of the mod too, it is just jarring in VR so I fixed it)
  • Removed eye adaptation

The removal of eye adaptation is pretty significant. Everything won’t get absurdly dark now when there’s an overcast. Eye adaptation usually just isn’t good in VR. Keep in mind, this will make nights considerably darker, tbh tarkov nights are a bit too bright anyway. I suggest using this mod too for darkness in interiors - https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2613/reduce-fake-interior-shadows#description

Don’t forget to install my cloud mod if you haven’t already. I have it connected to this as a dependency.

versions.description:
Hotfix Changelog:

  • Clouds no longer get cut off as bad at the horizon
  • Adjust brightness a bit on clouds during day time
  • Added a dither to the shader to help smooth out color banding specifically during night time

1.2.4 Upcoming Changes

  • Clouds have now been removed from SPT-VR - Download it here, big update for it too! - https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2567/cloudsix-cloud-replacement
  • Fixed DLSS/FSR quality changing mid-raid
  • Added support for Dynamic maps, the current version of Dynamic Maps has a few issues so you may see some nulls in your logs. Everything works though - Hold trigger and move to move the map around, hold trigger and move thumbstick up and down to zoom in/out

NOTE: Just to explain why I removed the clouds from SPT-VR - it just started getting confusing working with both of them moving changes between the two and testing on both. Separating it makes it so I just need to test them on flatscreen and if they’re working good there I know they’ll be good in VR. Also, this gives you the option of using older versions of my clouds.

versions.description:
Update Changelog:

  • Changed where clouds are getting initiated
  • Changed min and max cloud speed - cloud movement will be a lot more noticeable now especially during fast wind days
  • Re-did a lot of coloring/timing on the clouds to have longer lasting sunsets/sunrises
  • Night clouds have been improved
  • Improved shading on clouds, they should appear like they have more depth now
  • Overcast clouds improved, shouldn’t be blown out white anymore

Keep in mind, a lot of the coloring and brightness also heavily relies on what your postfx settings are. These clouds were made with postfx disabled to have a base look to the clouds.

Pictures (with my PostFx): https://imgur.com/a/wIIcLDI

Update Changelog:

NOTE: This build currently has a bug where DLSS/FSR quality will not change when changing the setting mid-raid. I have fixed this for the next update.

  • Adjustment to clouds, night will now have a base cloud color and brightness set. Having the night colors/brightness be based dynamically on the moon color wasn’t good and also hollywood graphics moon brightness adjustments made the clouds too bright
  • Artifacting around grass during winter season with ambient occlusion enabled fixed
  • Disabling DLSS will now work properly, it wasn’t working at all before
  • DLSS will not disable anymore while in inventory
  • Complete re-write of the upscaler quality selection, it’s much cleaner now
  • The above re-write fixes a really bad issue with DLSS that I didn’t notice, DLSS will now set the correct quality upon loading into hideout/raid

So regarding the last point, a tester noticed that when they turned DLSS off then back on mid-game, they would get better performance. After investigating this, I found that a bug was pretty much resetting your render resolution to 1x effectively gaining you no performance benefits. Disabling and re-enabling it would fix it. This is now resolved, so some people may notice a pretty good improvement in performance if you used DLSS.

NOTE: Just a reminder, if you are using SPT-VR, you don’t need my other two mods, AO Replacer and CloudSix. It’s built into SPT-VR because it requires it

Hotfix Changelog:

  • Various bug fixes to cloud code that wasn’t noticeable in-game
  • Fixed an issue where clouds didn’t spawn when going into your next raid
  • Fixed an issue where clouds weren’t appearing in scopes
  • Restored Tarkov’s cloud terrain shadows (they don’t line up with my clouds unfortunately but if you’re not paying attention to that it is a nice effect)
  • Fixed an issue where disabling DLSS wasn’t working
  • Adjusted AO to use Deferred/Gbuffer, this reduces the amount of AO you will see but it is a more accurate use of AO
  • Fixed an issue where setting TAA in graphics settings would break rendering
  • Fixed GPUInstancer frustum and occlusion culling in VR so the disable frustum and occlusion culling options in VR settings will be removed (tree’s still cull in the far right of your right eye, wasn’t able to figure out what culling is doing this)
  • Reduced a forced lodbiasfactor from 3 down to 1.5

About that last point - This has been forced to 3 for a while in the mod, I never paid much mind to it but when I was messing with that value in flatscreen, I noticed it would drop fps by 20-30 in some areas if set to 3. Unsure if this will have much of an effect on performance in VR though.

NOTE: If you are using Fika, update it! Extracting from raid will cause a crash if you’re not on the latest version of Fika

Update Changelog - The graphics update!

Just want to start by saying, this is mainly a graphics update for the mod to try and get things looking better. There’s two big parts of this update, new clouds, and new ambient occlusion method that is fully compatible with VR - GTAO. The clouds are using a totally custom made shader by me, I have spent a lot of time on this shader. Basically, it’s significantly more physically aware (I feel they look better than tarkov’s built in clouds at times). The GTAO completely replaces Tarkov’s AO and it works properly in VR, which means same shading in both eyes and it’s also a lot more accurate AO than Tarkov’s built in HBAO.

  • Improved upscaler support, just adjusted some things with jitter and the way things were being rendered which may improve quality (no more DLAA, to my surprise, DLAA actually uses a special wrapper that Tarkov does not support so it was not working properly)
  • Totally rewrote my custom cloud shader and scripting. It looks A LOT better now, the dome is now massive, you won’t see like the far buildings on customs behind the clouds anymore. Cloud lighting is fully dynamic based off the direction of the sun and color of sky/sun. Clouds are now being rendered directly through commandbuffer to avoid being effected by post fx, this keeps the clouds from being totally blown out
  • New AO implementation which totally replaces Tarkov’s AO. It’s now using GTAO instead of HBAO which is more accurate and also VR/Stereo compatible so you’ll see the shading the same in both eyes. To use it, just set the ambient occlusion setting in graphics tab to your preferred quality (colored ultra is the same as ultra)
  • Fixed Fika extract issue
  • Added support for new Fika loading bar
  • Fixed a long standing issue with MDR’s and possibly other guns getting stuck in animation if you med or eat while in inventory
  • New weapon weight system, it’s actually the best way to play now imo. It’s not as restrictive as it was, you’ll feel the weapon weight but if you pull/move your hand fast enough, it’ll respond much faster. So you’ll be able to make those quick adjustments without feeling like you’re pulling the gun through water
  • Re-added fog but I have it disabled by default, I’m going to look into a total fog replacement at some point. The fog I was using does not work nicely with the upscalers at all
  • Going prone no longer hides arms. Found out with Gbtonzee that my changes I made a while back to shoulder placement completely resolved the broken arms while prone
  • Dedicated in-game keyboard toggle - Thanks @mayoi for this! Check their github here - https://github.com/dasanibroto - Hope it helps people that can’t use the steamvr keyboard (they have another add-on they’re working on for sptvr that a lot of people have asked for )

Massively Small Feature Update!

  • DLSS, FSR2, and FSR3 are now fully supported!
  • Various long standing null fixes such as the “OnClick” null
  • Anti Aliasing and upscaler settings work in the graphics settings menu now (the AA option only works for off and FXAA)
  • Temporarily disabled fog completely, the custom fog I was using to replace tarkov’s fog does not work nicely with upscalers because of the camera jitter. I’ll look into a new solution, I tried really damn hard to fix it with no luck.

But yeah, this is a HUGE improvement to visual clarity AND performance. Especially for Nvidia users, DLSS with preset K looks actually really damn good in VR.

This is a long time coming. It’s something I’ve been trying to get working since I’ve taken over on development. To say this was hard to figure out… is an understatement. Basically soon after the last update, I had an idea that partially worked for it and since then I’ve been non-stop every day all day working on getting it all working properly. One thing led to another, I ended up writing up A LOT of a custom stuff here. It was a massive headache, I never realized how many small details go into these upscaler solutions…

  • Custom stereo upscaler wrapper for all upscalers (except FSR1 because really.. why would you use that)
  • Custom jitter handler for the camera
  • Lots of patching work to bypass tarkov’s rendering systems and settings to set my own quality presets
